articles.title: Sabrina Carpenter Mourns Dolly Parton: 'We Look Like We Could Be Sisters!'
articles.summary: After Dolly Parton's death at 80, Sabrina Carpenter shared heartfelt memories of their collaboration. Dolly had called her 'a little sister' and praised their similar voices.

articles.title: Pixel 11 Pro Fold: A Great First Foldable, But Not Worth Upgrading From the 10
articles.summary: Google's Pixel 11 Pro Fold offers minor upgrades over its predecessor — a faster chip, brighter screens, and faster wireless charging. But the crease is more visible than rivals, and the battery is smaller.

articles.title: Merlin's Cave: How a Queen Used Magic to Sell Her Dynasty
articles.summary: In 1735, Queen Caroline built a cave with wax figures of Merlin and King Arthur to make her German family seem more British. It was a clever PR move that even critics couldn't ignore.
